price_origin: Frozen raw daily prices collected 2026-09-04, no later trading session by 2026-09-05. Adjusted open = raw open * adjusted close / raw close.
peer_observations: Repeated stock pairs are dependent; no binomial significance or 256k independent trials claim.
rank_method: Both directions net wins; ties by wins then losses then ticker, fixed before inspecting this backtest. Other views are sensitivity only.
liquid_filter: Diagnostic exclusion of PNK/OTC exchange or any zero-volume days; does not certify tradability of remaining names.
omitted_price_rows: Six raw records lacked usable open/close/adj_close or positive prices; not fill-zero returns.
